title: A meromorphic function vanishing on a principal open is annihilated by a power of the defining section
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a quasi-compact scheme, a meromorphic function whose restriction to the principal open defined by a section h vanishes is annihilated by a power of h (statement lines 6241-6246). The counted proof reduces the statement to finitely many affine opens on which the meromorphic function is a quotient of a section by a nonzerodivisor, discards the denominator using that it is a nonzerodivisor, and then reads the annihilation statement off the fact that vanishing in a localization means being killed by a power of the inverted element (proof lines 6248-6258). It is H2: the reductions and the final step are carried out in the counted span and use only the local description of meromorphic functions.
